runs.name: Kadant Inc.; NYSE KAI, formerly Thermo Fibertek to 2001; engineered systems, parts and consumables for paper, packaging, wood products, mining and recycling, in Flow Control, Industrial Processing and Material Handling; Babbini 2025, Kadant Profil 2026; no rival named in the 10-K, Albany International and Xerium read as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.entry: Price **$264.15** a share (quote of 2026-10-16 printed by `tools/run.py`; aggregator, flagged). Shares **11,809,117** common, one class (10-Q Q2 2026 cover as of 2026-07-31, `0000886346-26-000052`; 14,624,159 issued less 2,815,057 treasury at 2026-07-04, a 15-share difference); cap **$3,119.4M**. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-15). Documents read: 10-K FY2025 (`0000886346-26-000018`), 10-Q Q2 2026, DEF 14A of 2026-04-01 (`0000886346-26-000027`), the 8-Ks of the Profil acquisition (`0000886346-26-000034`), the adjusted-EPS recast (`0000886346-26-000015`), the Q2 2026 results and the CEO succession (`0000886346-26-000055`), and the filings of the 2009 cycle. The brief's two stated departures: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7 (listed in the research folder's `notes.md`), and the competitors the 10-K names; it names none, so Albany International (Machine Clothing) and Xerium (filed to FY2017) were read as a CONVENTION of the run, Valmet, Andritz and Voith flagged as non-filers. **Q1 IN**: parts and consumables 71% of FY2025 revenue ($748.4M of $1,052.2M), capital equipment 29%, declining graphic grades 4%. **Q2 IN** on the deciding part, Flow Control, 44.6% of FY2021 to FY2025 segment profit (Industrial Processing 38.9%, Material Handling 16.5%): gross margin 50.8% to 52.9% FY2018 to FY2025, rising in FY2020 on organic volume down 9%, segment operating margin 21% to 26%; in 2009 the same product lines lost a quarter to a third of revenue while the older wider segment held gross margin at 40% against 42%; Albany Machine Clothing 14.0% (2007), 6.8% (2009), 28.1% to 22.1% (2023 to 2025), Xerium near a prepackaged chapter 11 in 2009. **Q3 WEIGHS FOR** (about 55% pre-tax on net tangible capital; purchases at a decent rate on price, carried to Q6). **Q4 accounts IN, WEIGHS AGAINST**: adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EPS featured, quarterly guidance, and adjusted EPS redefined on 2026-02-19 to add back intangible amortization, the day after FY2025 adjusted EPS of $9.26 missed its own $9.70 to $10.05 guidance. **Q5 integrity IN** (no legal proceedings, controls effective, the bad year reported plainly, an internal succession); ability weighs for. **Q6** Part A UNDECIDED (cash purchases, no buybacks), Part B WEIGHS AGAINST (pay on adjusted EBITDA and an 8% return-on-equity target; the 2025 bonus above target in a year earnings fell). Owner cash (operating cash less stock pay, all capital spending, finance-lease principal and minority dividends) FY2021 to FY2025 mean **$124.4M** all-equity, $117.6M equity-only; purchases of $638.7M against $621.8M of owner cash before purchases, so the serial-acquirer organic pair at 3.48%, the filer's organic revenue growth applied to owner cash (a step the analyst confessed). **Q7 OUT**: value range **$162 to $224** a share all-equity (equity-only $183 to $242), width 1.32, net debt $376.1M at 2026-07-04 deducted; the floor tested first, 3.6% (no growth) to 4.7% (organic growth) at the price, about 14.8% a year growth needed to clear ten percent; Profil (EUR 157.0M, closed 2026-04-30) credited at nothing with its debt counted, plus $14 a share if credited at its price. Fair **$88 all-equity** ($113 equity-only). Q8 to Q10 not reached; facts after the stop: gross debt $510.6M, almost all floating, revolver due 2030, leverage 1.33 before Profil. Contamination declared by the analyst: one `Test Runs/` listing filtered to today's date (other companies' run names, none for KAI), a listing of the STRL research folder's file names made by mistake, none opened, the STRL commit subjects and the memory index; none used. Self-audit departure declared: the Q7 arithmetic was first run during the reading, headed COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE, nothing entering the run file before Q7. Commits c0a83965 (Step 0 to Q1), ea3a9f3c (Q2), 536142cb (Q3), f9e6c6c1 (Q4), bd45f953 (Q5), 600e28d7 (Q6), 00438d8b (Q7), e9ea3091 (close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` 62 ids, 33 fragments, no problem; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 92 id occurrences, no missing id, no E-id, **one slip**: "out of line with sales" beside **[M1995-064]**, whose row reads "out of line, you know, with sales", an elision without [...] (two other flags were the checker reading a filing quote and a neighbouring row's quote, verified clean). Not fixed in the run file (operator rule 6). No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) the serial-acquirer organic pair credits organic revenue growth to owner cash, which assumes constant margins; (2) the parts rule lets 44.6% of the profit decide Q2 for the whole, Industrial Processing ($85.5M of past goodwill impairments) never judged; (3) the change-for-the-better test on a segment recast in 2018 has no rule; (4) the competitor departure fails where the rivals that matter do not file; (5) a deal closed after the window is credited at nothing while its debt counts; (6) Q4 and Q5 do not separate an add-back the rows endorse from the waving away of real costs. Could not get: a maintenance and growth split of capital spending, Profil's earnings, Flow Control figures for 2009, the machine builders' filings.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on price (Kadant, formerly Thermo Fibertek; parts, consumables and engineered systems for paper, packaging, wood products, mining and recycling in Flow Control, Industrial Processing and Material Handling). Q1 IN on 71% parts and consumables; Q2 IN on Flow Control, 44.6% of five-year segment profit, gross margin 50.8% to 52.9% through FY2020's volume fall and the product lines' 2009 test; Q4 accounts IN but against on adjusted figures and the adjusted-EPS redefinition of 2026-02-19, the day after a missed guide; Q5 integrity IN; Q6 against on pay. A serial acquirer ($638.7M of purchases against $621.8M of owner cash), so the organic pair at 3.48%: value $162 to $224 all-equity against $264.15, 3.6% to 4.7% at the price, fair $88 all-equity, $113 equity-only. One citation slip ([M1995-064], an elision unmarked). Framework gaps for the operator: organic revenue growth applied to owner cash, a 44.6% part deciding Q2, a recast segment's cycle test, a post-window deal credited at nothing, two kinds of adjusted figure.
runs.fair_label: KAI v5 fair price, all-equity: $88 a share (equity-only $113). Run 2026-10-16 (Test Runs/2026-10-16 Run - KAI Kadant.md; OUT at Q7 at $264.15; value range $162 to $224 at the 5.43% Treasury, the organic pair). Reporting figure, a prompt to re-run Q7, not a buy signal.
